title: Fix Spatial Play Default No Asset
description: Spatial play must start with no shape asset loaded and must not throw when clearing or selecting shape assets.
summary: Default shape asset is empty; emptyPlayModels/ensurePlayShapeModel always seed spatial.shape. handleShapeAssetChange uses empty model not empty model space. ensureDerivedModelInSpace no longer skips shape when record is empty. activeModel falls back instead of throw. Vitest 14/14.
